figurative_meaning_en: Having a granular or sandy texture
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভাতটা করকরে হয়ে গেছে, ভালো করে ধুয়নি।
example_sentences_in_english: The rice has turned grainy because it wasn't washed properly.
The soil has dried up into a sandy texture in the heat.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression mimicking the crunchy or granular sound/texture, commonly used in Bengali household contexts related to rice preparation.
